visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright, white photography studio. A female model with long black hair, wearing a light blue and white sailor-style dress with large bows and white knee-high boots, poses against a white backdrop. A photographer's hands and camera are visible in the foreground, capturing her movements. (2) A second female model enters the frame, wearing a similar costume but in bright yellow and white. The two interact, with the yellow-clad model demonstrating energetic, cheerful poses involving hand salutes and waist-holding. (3) The scene shifts to the models and staff interacting behind the scenes. A third female in a red version of the costume is seen briefly. They are gathered around a computer monitor showing the captured photos. (4) The final sequence shows a montage of the finished professional photographs of the model in the blue costume, showcasing various cute and energetic poses against the clean white background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A mechanical camera shutter click sounds. High-pitched, energetic female voices speaking Mandarin emerge over a bright, mid-tempo electronic pop BGM. The voices sound excited and cheerful. (2) Repeated shutter clicks are heard as the conversation becomes more animated with laughter. The BGM remains constant with a steady 4/4 beat. (3) The vocal density increases as multiple females joke and give directions. The tone is humorous and high-arousal. (4) The voices recede as the BGM volume swells, transitioning into an upbeat vocal pop track in English during the final montage.
